requiredFindings.problem: Item 5 applies ANCHOR_SOURCE, ANCHOR_RANGE and ANCHOR_UTF8 at F5, before a view exists, by calling the owner, and says every refusal in that item, including an in-host syntax candidate, takes MJ row 30. The only function that emits those three keys requires a view that already names the facts. Item 14 runs that function after minting and classifies every refusal as a host invariant. Item 22 repeats that classification for the view self-check (MJ row 29). Item 16 sends every refusal of a record E3 hands H to the host-internal row. A provider anchor that misses the blob, overruns it, or splits UTF-8 therefore has no check that both calls the cited owner and takes the producer-boundary row. Item 5 also rejects the host copy that would be the other way to run the byte checks early.

IE:164 and IE:1426-1429 state the byte-range and inventoried-blob rule. IE:1038 uses FACT_ANCHOR_CARDINALITY as prose, not as the owner's runtime key. Item 5 rejects a host copy of the anchor law.
requiredFindings.fix: Keep payload and snapshot joins on inspect_relation_payload and inspect_relation_snapshot, and record that owner's RelationRule text as the diagnostic key. Run ANCHOR_SOURCE, ANCHOR_RANGE and ANCHOR_UTF8 once inside the item 14 call, after the view names the facts. When the fact came from a provider return, those three keys take MJ row 30. FACT_SOURCE_PRODUCER_JOIN, FACT_SCOPE_JOIN and an overlap H introduced take MJ row 29. For a record E3 handed H, every item-5 refusal, including those three anchor keys, stays host-internal. Qualify line 259 so it covers provider returns only, and qualify item 14 so a view-join refusal is a host invariant only for the keys H itself assembled.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: Item 10 says H computes the census inside coverage.rs and that it is never a caller argument, citing coverage.rs:21-27. Those lines are the evaluator struct CoverageUnresolvedEdge. CoverageProducerInput.unresolved (coverage.rs:28-32) is a caller-supplied slice, and the comment at coverage.rs:21-22 says the owning host view supplies it. The same paragraph already passes that slice to inspect_coverage_producer. The rule is sound once coverage.rs means the child module fact_admission/coverage.rs: the caller of H does not supply the census, and the inspector does not prove it complete. Name the child path on the next touch.
